selected_candidate.selection_unit: MACrossoverStrategy operational behavior on fixed ETF basket

hypothesis.question: Whether the frozen operational MA alignment rule produces positive net directional edge per non-overlapping episode after the frozen cost model in the formal OOS period.
hypothesis.population: fixed basket of SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, XLK, XLF, XLE, TLT and GLD
hypothesis.trigger: daily regular-session close with SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200 and close > SMA20, or the exact bearish inverse, subject to the operational gate
hypothesis.entry_timestamp: next regular US equity session open
hypothesis.holding_horizon: first frozen stop/target or twentieth future regular session close
hypothesis.predicted_effect: positive mean net directional return and rejection of the frozen sign-permutation null

universe.method: fixed ETF basket selected before outcome inspection
universe.survivorship_scope: fixed ETF basket only; no current equity index membership inference
universe.inception_closure_policy: instrument must have valid point-in-time bars; closed instruments are not replaced

operational_signal_semantics.implementation: MACrossoverStrategy.Analyze followed by the Jax scheduler actionable gate
operational_signal_semantics.pullback_branch: excluded: source confidence is 0.55 and the existing operational gate rejects it
operational_signal_semantics.bearish_signals: included as short-direction research measurements; no execution authority

confidence_contract.formula: base 0.65 + 0.12 when MarketTrend agrees + 0.08 when Volume > AvgVolume20 + 0.10 when directional abs(SMA20-SMA200)/SMA200 > 0.05, capped at 1.00
confidence_contract.market_trend: bullish iff SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200; bearish iff SMA20 < SMA50 < SMA200; otherwise neutral
confidence_contract.avg_volume: arithmetic mean of last 20 eligible volumes

indicator_contract.sma20: arithmetic mean of last 20 eligible closes
indicator_contract.sma50: arithmetic mean of last 50 eligible closes
indicator_contract.sma200: arithmetic mean of last 200 eligible closes
indicator_contract.atr14: arithmetic mean of last 14 true ranges; true_range=max(high-low,abs(high-previous_close),abs(low-previous_close)); first bar without previous close excluded
indicator_contract.avg_volume20: arithmetic mean of last 20 eligible volumes
indicator_contract.window_rule: only bars available at the signal close; insufficient/invalid history abstains

price_and_corporate_action_contract.dividend_treatment: excluded from indicators; long receives and short pays cash distribution when held through ex-date using point-in-time record
price_and_corporate_action_contract.split_treatment: no retrospective back-adjustment; apply prospectively on effective session; if an indicator window crosses a split, abstain until 200 valid post-split sessions

protocol.entry: next regular US equity session open strictly after signal close
protocol.exit: first frozen stop/target or twentieth future regular-session close
protocol.gap_rule: if the next open crosses a level, entry and immediate exit resolve at the open; no impossible fill outside the bar
protocol.intrabar_order: open crossing first; otherwise touched levels; stop before target when both are touched
protocol.session_calendar: deterministic Jax US regular-session calendar with UTC storage and US/Eastern interpretation
protocol.missing_data: record abstention; never impute or create a trade

exit_contract.target_selection: first TakeProfit only; source second target ignored because scheduler persists TakeProfit[0]
exit_contract.time_exit: close of twentieth future regular session
exit_contract.reentry: prohibited while instrument episode is active

bearish_economics.spread_slippage_commission_impact: charged on entry and exit legs
bearish_economics.borrow: 20 bps per held trading day on short notional
bearish_economics.dividend_liability: explicit cash outflow for short held through ex-date

cost_model.application: commission/spread/slippage/impact on each leg; borrow only for SELL/short episodes; gross and net retained; primary uses net

analysis_units.primary: fixed 10000 USD analytical notional per non-overlapping episode
analysis_units.quantity_formula: primary_notional_usd / raw_entry_price; fractional quantity is analytical normalization only
analysis_units.primary_return: direction_sign * (exit_value-entry_value)/entry_value minus round-trip costs and signed corporate-action cash flows, divided by fixed entry notional
analysis_units.net_return_formula: (direction_sign * quantity * (exit_raw_price - entry_raw_price) + direction_sign * quantity * dividend_cash_per_share - entry_leg_cost - exit_leg_cost - short_borrow_cost) / entry_notional
analysis_units.leg_cost_formula: commission_per_order + leg_raw_price * quantity * (commission_bps + spread_bps + slippage_bps + market_impact_bps) / 10000
analysis_units.short_borrow_formula: SELL only: entry_notional * borrow_bps_per_held_trading_day / 10000 * held_future_trading_sessions; BUY=0
analysis_units.corporate_action_cash_sign: long dividend receipt positive; short dividend liability negative

portfolio_secondary.cap_breach: new portfolio episode not allocated; primary episode observation remains

partitions.holdout_access: metadata/schema/hash only; no bars, signals, episodes, outcomes or semantics

sample_and_dependence.dependence_unit: instrument-year block; overlapping episodes deduplicated per instrument

primary_metric.name: MEAN_NET_DIRECTIONAL_RETURN_PER_NON_OVERLAPPING_EPISODE
primary_metric.null: no positive net directional edge; mean <= 0
primary_metric.test: one-sided instrument-year block-bootstrap 95% lower bound for the observed mean plus preregistered within-instrument-year sign-permutation randomization test
primary_metric.test_statistic: M = arithmetic mean of net_return_formula over eligible non-overlapping episodes
primary_metric.permutation_p_value: (1 + null statistics >= observed M) / (1 + 10000), with directions permuted only within instrument-year blocks
primary_metric.permutation_role: falsification/comparative null; it cannot be replaced or tuned after outcomes
primary_metric.success: positive net mean, 95% lower bound above zero, and candidate mean above the 95th percentile of the frozen sign-permutation null

bootstrap.seed_derivation: first eight big-endian bytes of SHA-256(manifest_sha256 || |instrument-year-bootstrap-v1|)

falsification_suite.registration_rule: exactly this list; failures retained; no post-OOS additions used to repair the thesis

calibration.ordinal_resolution: descriptive confidence buckets only; no post-result filtering

failure_rules: effect exists only in one unregistered slice

val_02b_execution_economics_and_statisti.entry_reference: next regular-session raw open; signal close is never an entry price
val_02b_execution_economics_and_statisti.exit_order: next-open gap resolution, then open-crossing, then intraday range touch; stop has priority over target; time exit last
val_02b_execution_economics_and_statisti.gap_fill: open reference when open crosses a level; no fill outside the observed bar range
primary_success_requires: 95 percent block-bootstrap lower bound above zero
